name: Round Solid Oak Pedestal Dining Table
description: A round dining table in solid white oak with a chamfered-underside top carried on a single turned column pedestal that flares into a four-toe cruciform foot.
materials: Solid white oak throughout, top with a forty-five degree chamfered underside edge and grain running across the face, a single turned column pedestal, a four-toe cruciform foot with softened arrises, hardwax-oil finish.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, inlay, veneer seam or decorative carving; never add a glass top, an extension leaf or a metal base; never add chairs, tableware or props except where an angle explicitly calls for scale context.
preservationNotes: Keep the same round chamfered-edge top diameter relative to the pedestal, the single turned column, and the four-toe cruciform foot consistent across all five angles.
